Metline Industries (Steel Pipes & Tube Division) is an ISO 9001:2008 Certified manufacturer and supplier of IS:1239 Steel Pipes/Tubes. We stock an extensive range of electric resistance welded (ERW) IS:1239 steel pipes / tubes in a size range of 1/2 inch N.B. to 6 inch N.B. in the Light, Medium and Heavy classes. METLINE also offers black steel pipes in compliance with IS: 3589-2001 and IS: 10577-1982.
Request for Our Latest Prices on High Quality IS:1239 ERW Steel Pipes! Exports is Our Specialty!!
As one of the leading suppliers of IS:1239 steel pipes in Mumbai, Metline Industries (Steel Pipes & Tube Division) stocks an extensive range of electric resistance welded (ERW) IS:1239 steel pipes in a size range of 15mm. N.B. to 150mm N.B. in the Light, Medium and Heavy classes. METLINE also offers steel pipes in compliance with IS: 3589-2001 and IS: 10577-1982.
All IS:1239 steel pipes and black tubes supplied by METLINE are produced in accordance with ASTM /IS/BS specifications. At METLINE, we strictly adhere the scheme of Testing and Inspecting laid down by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS).
